keySpaces.label: Summary moments, then Moran, Geary and G blocks

formulas.ascii: I = n * sum_ij w_ij c_i c_j / (S0 * sum c_i^2); E[I] = -1/(n-1); z = (I - E[I]) / sqrt(V_rand); p = erfc(|z| / sqrt(2)) for the default two-sided tail. c = x - mean over the n analysis rows; S0 = sum w_ij over included pairs; V_rand is esda VI_rand (sample kurtosis). Geary C and General G use the same z and p with their own moments. For G, E[G] = S0/(n(n-1)); both inference triples report the analytical VG and normal approximation, evaluated in centered form. Binary weights and islands = keep match esda.G; row weights give a weighted generalization. Inference is undefined for n < 4 or S0 = 0. Constant positive data give G variance zero (z and p undefined); G also requires non-negative values and a positive pair-product denominator.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
y[s]=sum|min|max of x[offsets[s]..offsets[s+1]-1], empty=0; no mask or nonfinite filter. Min/max fold from type extrema (finite f32 extrema); integer sums wrap at 32 bits.
